semiconductor_relevance: High — APP provides specialized plasma equipment for various semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: APP specializes in atmospheric pressure plasma technologies, offering a range of equipment for semiconductor applications such as cleaning, activation, lamination, bonding, coating, printing, plating, etching, and ashing. Their proprietary ArP® brand provides unique plasma solutions addressing size, power, and control challenges.
